snippet.title: Olga Episode 1 - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2836740/Olga__Episode_1

Relive Olga's childhood memories as she visits her grandparents' home in Belovodica, a secluded mountain village where some discoveries last a lifetime.

ABOUT THE GAME:
Olga is an episodic first-person narrative walking simulator game with a simple story and stylized visuals inspired by Slavic Culture.

After coming across what’s seemingly the biggest career opportunity of their lives, Olga’s parents leave the country for a few months, leaving her at her grandparents’ home in Belovodica, a hidden, isolated village deep within the mountains.

The story unfolds at a time when communication devices, such as cell phones, were not available to those living in such areas.

All Belovodica has to offer Olga is an isolated, peaceful, and quiet life with her old grandparents, or at least that’s what she wanted to believe…
